mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the year-over-year change of CPIAUCSL indicates disinflation, reducing real interest rate expectations and increasing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy change declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above their 12-month moving averages indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS exceed their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.5%), a decline in FEDFUNDS signals aggressive monetary easing to combat inflation, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5%) when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the monthly change of PAYEMS indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS monthly change is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a 3-month rolling average, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 100 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer demand, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises and HOUST falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.5% and HOUST above 1300), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 qoq > 2.5% and HOUST > 1300) when RSAFS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
